metadata.question: Did the water extent of Elephant Butte Reservoir decrease between June 12, 1986 and June 9, 2020

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Elephant Butte Reservoir (I need to define a geometry around it) - Date: June 12, 1986 and June 9, 2020 - Data: Landsat 5 for 1986 (Landsat 5 launched in 1984) and Landsat 8 for 2020 - Need to calculate water extent for both dates 2. Masking strategy: - This is about water detection, not clouds specifically - Use NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) to detect water - Apply cloud masking to get clean water detection 3. Logic: - Calculate water area for both dates using NDWI threshold - Compare if 2020 area < 1986 area - Need to handle cases where no data or no valid pixels Approach: - Define geometry around Elephant Butte Reservoir (New Mexico) - Get Landsat 5 image for 1986-06-12 ±15 days - Get Landsat 8 image for 2020-06-09 ±15 days - Calculate NDWI and threshold to get water mask - Calculate water area for both - Compare areas ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const reservoir = ee.Geometry.Point([-107.1847, 33.1494]).buffer(5000); // Elephant Butte Reservoir, NM // Date ranges (±15 days for cloud-free composite) const date1986 = ee.Date('1986-06-12'); const date2020 = ee.Date('2020-06-09'); const range15days = 15 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 15 days in milliseconds // 2. Data Acquisition - Landsat 5 for 1986, Landsat 8 for 2020 const landsat5 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(reservoir) .filterDate(date1986.advance(-range15days, 'milliseconds'), date1986.advance(range15days, 'milliseconds')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20)); const landsat8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(reservoir) .filterDate(date2020.advance(-range15days, 'milliseconds'), date2020.advance(range15days, 'milliseconds')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20)); // Check collection sizes const count1986 = landsat5.size().getInfo(); const count2020 = landsat8.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1986 Images: ${count1986}, 2020 Images: ${count2020}`); if (count1986 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get median composites const img1986 = landsat5.median().clip(reservoir); const img2020 = landsat8.median().clip(reservoir); // 3. Water Detection using NDWI function calculateNDWI(img) { // For Landsat 5: Green = B2, NIR = B4 // For Landsat 8: Green = B3, NIR = B5 const green = img.select('SR_B2'); // Both use same band names in C2 collection const nir = img.select('SR_B4'); return green.subtract(nir).divide(green.add(nir)).rename('NDWI'); } const ndwi1986 = calculateNDWI(img1986); const ndwi2020 = calculateNDWI(img2020); // Water mask (NDWI > 0 threshold) const water1986 = ndwi1986.gt(0); const water2020 = ndwi2020.gt(0); // 4. Calculate water areas const scale = 30; // Landsat resolution const area1986 = water1986.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: reservoir, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); const area2020 = water2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: reservoir, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); // Count valid pixels to check for C2 const count1986Pixels = water1986.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: reservoir, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); const count2020Pixels = water2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: reservoir, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`1986 Water Pixels: ${area1986}, Total Pixels: ${count1986Pixels}`); console.log(`2020 Water Pixels: ${area2020}, Total Pixels: ${count2020Pixels}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (count1986Pixels === 0 || count2020Pixels === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (area1986 === null || area2020 === null || isNaN(area1986) || isNaN(area2020)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // 5. Final comparison const decreasePercent = ((area1986 - area2020) / area1986 * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`Water extent change: ${decreasePercent}%`); if (area2020 < area1986) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
